unresolved: The 17 published cases in the literature review and Table 2, and the pooled literature statistics, are not patients of this series; they are not individuated and no facts were recorded for them.
Patients are numbered by first mention including the abstract, which names the second, third and fourth patients before Case 1 appears, so p1 is Case 2, p2 is Case 3, p3 is Case 4 and p4 is Case 1.
The abstract sentence that one patient required a tracheotomy for severe dyspnea does not label the patient and was not assigned.

Table 1 gives Relapse as the outcome for Cases 1 to 3 without a time point, while the text reports no recurrence at the end of follow-up (Case 3: no recurrence of nasal stenosis or epistaxis); because the relapse is not placed in time the pair is recorded as an ambiguity, with the Table relapse review only and the text statements kept.

Table 1 prints Rhinorrhagia where the Case 3 text says rhinorrhea, Dermal division where the Case 1 text says subepithelial splitting, and After tracheotomy as the Case 4 initial symptom; none is reconciled.
Rituximab for Case 3 appears in the abstract, Table 1 and discussion but not in the case narrative; no dose or timing is stated.
The Case 1 dosage reduction sentence does not name the drug and mixes per-kilogram and absolute doses; recorded as printed.
The Case 3 text cites Supplemental Video 1 but the source declares no supplement or video asset; the video is unavailable media, not viewed or reviewed (complete, flagged), and no facts come from it.
The Figure 1 flow chart prints 115 retrieved records while the methods text says 113; the printed values are pixel content only and no patient fact depends on them.
Figure 7 is cited in the text as panels A to C but the image is a single unlabelled panel.
Figure captions describe immunofluorescence images as electron microscope images; this is caption wording only.
The abstract tracheotomy sentence is attributed by the abstract to the fourth patient, but the case text gives no indication for that tracheotomy; the stated reason (severe dyspnea) is not assigned.

key_findings: Four index patients; numbering by earliest identity evidence (abstract ordinals) gives p1=Case 2, p2=Case 3, p3=Case 4, p4=Case 1; 17 literature cases (Table 2) excluded.
Table 1 Relapse for Cases 1-3 has no time point; text no-recurrence statements kept, Table relapse review-only ambiguous.
Case 3 rituximab is literally attributed to the third patient in abstract, Table 1 and discussion (after IVIG), but without dose or timing.
Case 4 recommended steroid dose not asserted as given or planned; decannulation not asserted.
Supplemental Video 1 is cited but no asset is declared: unavailable media, complete-flagged, no facts from it.
residual_risks: The relapse/no-recurrence pair could still be a true source conflict if the table and text refer to the same follow-up.
Table 1 involvement items are coded as conditions with verification_status unknown; another reviewer could prefer folding them into the MMP diagnosis.
Figure 9 is captioned as laryngeal DIF; pixels show keratinized epithelium-like tissue, not adjudicated.
